thread:
maria: FYI onboarding sample with Typescript + Cloudflare runner is blowing up for new users. Error: "Cannot find type definition for '@redwood-inference/sdk'" even though node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist has index.d.ts

sam: is this a TS resolution issue or package exports problem?

maria: looks like TS tries to follow "types" field but bundler/resolver picks the CJS require path from exports for runtime. Then the IDE/tsserver can't map types to the chosen entry and shows missing types.

lee: can you paste package.json (exports + types)?

maria: pasted snippet: 

```
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```

maria: note we added ./types subpath to expose types but tsserver still complains for some setups.

toni: TS resolver doesn't always read exports map for typings unless "typesVersions" or a direct "types" mapping is present. Also some bundlers will pick the require entry and tools like tsserver may not correlate the conditional exports with the types path.

sam: could be edge runtimes too: wrangler/esbuild select the require entry which causes bundling to include `globalThis.process` shims; then runtime auth code thinks it's in Node and tries to use node-fetch fallback -> auth retries fail. So two separate DX hits (types + runtime) from same exports map.

lee: quick fixes: 1) add a top-level "types" field (we already have), 2) add a conditional export for "worker" that points at mjs, 3) include a "types" export condition: 

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "worker": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

maria: tried that locally, improves resolver behavior in TS and wrangler picks mjs now. But tsserver still complains intermittently in older VSCode/TS versions.

toni: we should add a README note in the SDK repo about recommended TS version and editor settings, plus a small migration note for consumers adding the browser/worker override as a fallback.

ci-bot: opened issue #812 in sdk repo: "exports map + typings interplay causing TS & worker resolution issues" (assigned to @lee).

sam: follow-ups: add tests that run tsserver resolution with different TS versions, add bundler matrix tests (esbuild/rollup/webpack + wrangler), and include a sample starter that pins the workaround in package.json so new users have smooth onboarding.

maria: I'll update the onboarding docs and link the issue. We should push a patch release with worker conditional + types export to reduce friction. Thanks all. :sparkles:
